items.title: If AI wins, don't AI companies lose?
items.raw_excerpt: Let's play it out in the case of software engineers. 100 SWEs all running Claude Code. Okay, company is 10x more productive than before. And now Claude revenue drops by 10x multiple? So if AI gets good, it will reduce the very engineering headcount that AI companies depend on, right?

items.title: Night Core – A WASM execution firewall for AI agents and untrusted code
items.raw_excerpt: I’ve been exploring the risks of letting autonomous AI agents generate or execute code — especially via WASM. Night Core is a lightweight console that treats execution as a boundary, not just output. It uses signature-based validation, human approval queues, and sandboxed runtimes (like Wasmtime) to let you review or reject what runs — before it happens. Demo screenshots: https://x.com/xnfinitecore/status/2010067157774991457?s=46 Still early, but open to ideas, pushback, and contributions. Curious if others are thinking about this edge.

items.title: What happens to an economy when AI makes most human labor optional
items.raw_excerpt: I keep seeing two extreme futures discussed around AI. One is techno utopia: AI does everything, productivity explodes, humans are free to create and chill. The other is collapse: AI replaces jobs, wealth concentrates, consumption dies, society implodes. What I don’t see discussed enough is the mechanism between those states. If AI systems genuinely outperform humans at most economically valuable tasks, wages are no longer the primary distribution mechanism. But capitalism today assumes wages are how demand exists. No wages means no buyers. No buyers means even the owners of AI have no customers. That feels less like a social problem and more like a systems contradiction. Historically, automation shifted labor rather than deleting it. But AI is different in that it targets cognition itself

items.title: GlyphLang – An AI-first programming language

The accumulating context from the codebase was eating through tokens fast. So I built a language designed to be generated by AI rather than written by humans. title_i18n.es: El Asistente de IA de Google podría ser un anticipo del futuro de Gmail.

excerpt_i18n.en: This week, Google announced a new AI Inbox view for Gmail that replaces the traditional list of emails with an AI-generated list of to-dos and topics to track based on what's in your inbox. It's not widely available yet, but I have access, and in the few hours I've spent messing around with it, I […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本周，谷歌为Gmail推出了一项新的AI收件箱视图，该功能将传统的邮件列表替换为由AI生成的待办事项与主题追踪清单，其内容依据用户收件箱信息自动生成。目前该功能尚未广泛开放。
excerpt_i18n.es: Esta semana, Google anunció una nueva vista de bandeja de entrada con IA para Gmail que reemplaza la lista tradicional de correos con una lista generada por IA de tareas pendientes y temas a seguir, basada en el contenido de tu bandeja de entrada. Aún no está ampliamente disponible.

items.title: MANZANO: A Simple and Scalable Unified Multimodal Model with a Hybrid Vision Tokenizer
items.raw_excerpt: Unified multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) that can both understand and generate visual content hold immense potential. However, existing open-source models often suffer from a performance trade-off between these capabilities. We present Manzano, a simple and scalable unified framework that substantially reduces this tension by coupling a hybrid image tokenizer with a well-curated training recipe. A single shared vision encoder feeds two lightweight adapters that produce continuous embeddings for image-to-text understanding and discrete tokens for text-to-image generation within a common…

title_i18n.en: MANZANO: A Simple and Scalable Unified Multimodal Model with a Hybrid Vision Tokenizer
title_i18n.zh: 马扎诺：一种简单且可扩展的统一多模态模型，配备混合视觉分词器
title_i18n.es: MANZANO: Un Modelo Unificado Multimodal Simple y Escalable con un Tokenizador Visual Híbrido

excerpt_i18n.en: Unified multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) that can both understand and generate visual content hold immense potential. However, existing open-source models often suffer from a performance trade-off between these capabilities. We present Manzano, a simple and scalable unified framework that substantially reduces this tension by coupling a hybrid image tokenizer with a well-curated training recipe. A single shared vision encoder feeds two lightweight adapters that produce continuous embeddings for image-to-text understanding and discrete tokens for text-to-image generation within a common…
excerpt_i18n.zh: 统一的多模态大型语言模型（LLMs）既能理解又能生成视觉内容，具有巨大潜力。然而，现有的开源模型往往在这两种能力之间存在性能权衡。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los modelos de lenguaje grandes (LLM) multimodales unificados, capaces tanto de comprender como de generar contenido visual, poseen un inmenso potencial. Sin embargo, los modelos de código abierto existentes suelen adolecer de una compensación de rendimiento entre estas capacidades.

items.title: Don't fall into the anti-AI hype
items.raw_excerpt: The article cautions against excessive hype about AI risks, arguing that anti-AI sentiment could hinder technological innovation. It advocates for a balanced approach to AI development that considers both progress and societal impacts.

title_i18n.en: Don't fall into the anti-AI hype
title_i18n.zh: 别陷入反人工智能的炒作中
title_i18n.es: No caigas en la histeria anti-IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: The article cautions against excessive hype about AI risks, arguing that anti-AI sentiment could hinder technological innovation. It advocates for a balanced approach to AI development that considers both progress and societal impacts.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章指出当前存在过度炒作人工智能风险的倾向，认为这种反AI情绪可能阻碍技术创新。作者主张理性看待AI发展，平衡技术进步与社会影响，避免陷入非黑即白的极端讨论。
